name: Mizunami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mizunami city emblem in blue and light blue: a blue and light blue disc bearing a white swirl of comma shapes.
history: Municipal flag of Mizunami, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1954.
